title: Term Life Insurance Face Band Factors After the Accidental Death Rider Ends
content:
In the installment after the accidental death rider ends on a Term Life Insurance policy, the band factor applied to the face premium is read from the band measurement face.

**Renewable ladder** — the Ashgrove Annual Renewable Term, and any term policy past its level premium period: 0.82 at 1000000 or more; 0.86 from 500000 up to 1000000; 0.92 from 250000 up to 500000; 1.00 below 250000.

**Level term ladder** — a level term policy within its level premium period: 0.74 at 1000000 or more; 0.80 from 500000 up to 1000000; 0.88 from 250000 up to 500000; 1.00 below 250000.

A level term policy is past its level premium period once the whole months from its issue date to today reach twelve times its premium guarantee period in years.

| Hypothetical case | Ladder | Factor |
|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Level Term 25, 26th policy year, band measurement face 1050000 | renewable | 0.82 |
| Ashgrove Level Term 30, 20th policy year, band measurement face 900000 | level term | 0.80 |
| Ashgrove Annual Renewable Term, band measurement face 249500 | renewable | 1.00 |
